user.title: Connect to the Zwolle Parkeerloket
user.description: Enter the Meldnummer and Pincode of your parking permit.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The credentials for Meldnummer {meldnummer} are no longer accepted. Enter the current Pincode.

error.invalid_auth: The Meldnummer or Pincode is incorrect.
error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Zwolle Parkeerloket.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while talking to the Zwolle Parkeerloket.

init.title: Options
init.description: The portal is a shared production system, so keep the polling interval generous.

start_booking.name: Start booking
start_booking.description: Book a parking session for a licence plate, starting now, for the portal's default duration.

license_plate.name: Licence plate
license_plate.description: Plate to book. The portal refuses a plate that already has an overlapping booking.

stop_booking.name: Stop booking
stop_booking.description: Cancel the parking session of a licence plate, refunding the unused minutes.

license_plate.name: Licence plate
license_plate.description: Plate whose parking session to cancel.

change_booking_time.name: Change booking time
change_booking_time.description: Extend or shorten the parking session of a licence plate.

license_plate.name: Licence plate
license_plate.description: Plate whose parking session to change.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Minutes to add, or a negative number of minutes to take away. Extending spends balance; shortening refunds it.

no_target.message: Select the parking account to act on.

no_booking_for_plate.message: There is no parking session for {plate}.

plate_required.message: No licence plate to book. Fill in the licence plate field first.

invalid_plate.message: {plate} is not a valid licence plate.

plate_already_parked.message: {plate} is already parked. The portal refuses two overlapping bookings for one licence plate.

several_bookings.message: Several cars are parked, so it is not clear which booking this button means. Use the stop_booking or change_booking_time action with a licence plate, or the calendar.

cannot_extend.message: This session cannot be extended by {minutes} minutes. It already ends at {until}, which is as far as the portal allows.

cannot_shorten.message: This session cannot be shortened by {minutes} minutes without ending it.

unknown_booking.message: The portal no longer lists that booking. Refresh and try again.

plate_not_found.message: The portal does not know this licence plate.

cannot_connect_write.message: Could not reach the Zwolle Parkeerloket; the action was not applied.

calendar_start_is_fixed.message: A booking cannot be moved: it starts at {start}. The portal only changes how long it lasts.

calendar_plate_is_fixed.message: The licence plate of a booking cannot be changed. Cancel it and book again for the other plate.

calendar_whole_days.message: A parking booking cannot be an all-day event.
